reason: A sparkling cold-brewed mate with nothing added is exactly the kind of new can I grab from a café fridge and post if it's good. 55 CZK is nothing for me, so I'd try it once or twice, but I'm not ordering a case from an e-shop off the bat.
objection: Novelty wears off fast. Unless it really tastes great and the 80 mg actually carries me through a gym session, it'll be one post and back to what I already drink.
would_change_my_mind: For buying regularly rather than once: if it tastes clearly better than the other mate drinks and is in the fridge at the gym or the cafés I go to, so I don't have to plan for it.
